subject: Renewal amendment: invoice carve-out & capacity uplift (BrightWave)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: BrightWave Procurement <procure@brightwave.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal amendment: invoice carve-out & capacity uplift (BrightWave)

Hi team,

Following our call this morning, we scoped the renewal amendment and a pragmatic billing path that keeps your finance and cloud teams aligned while letting you ramp capacity ahead of the formal procurement window. High-level proposal: 

- Commit uplift: move from current 12k tokens/day equivalent to 36k tokens/day (3x) effective 2028-06-01; billed as the primary committed invoice.
- Invoice carve-out for overage (burst usage): any usage beyond committed capacity will be billed on a separate monthly invoice with a different invoice reference so it can be carved out to your CloudOps budget (per your request).
- Evidence bundle: we attached an evidence manifest (usage projections, SLA acceptance notes) to speed Marketplace acceptance.

Actions we need from BrightWave to proceed:
1) Confirm PO number and correct legal entity name + tax ID to appear on the amendment and invoices.
2) Confirm whether you want a single invoice per month with line-item split or two distinct invoices (we recommend two distinct invoices to simplify your internal chargeback).
3) Review the attached private_offer_amendment draft and the evidence manifest; we'll push a DocuSign when you confirm.

Attachments: brightwave_evidence_manifest.xlsx, private_offer_amendment_v2.pdf

Proposed timeline: sign amendment (DocuSign) by 2028-05-20 -> Private Offer activation 2028-06-01 -> first carve-out invoice 2028-07-01 for June overages.

If helpful, Jane Lee from AWS Marketplace is looped in for any marketplace-specific PO formatting rules.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

On calls: we kept the legal/finance asks minimal to avoid blocking the uplift.
From: BrightWave Procurement <procure@brightwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightWave CloudOps <cloudops@brightwave.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment: invoice carve-out & capacity uplift (BrightWave)

Marissa —

Thanks for the write-up. A few clarifications from procurement and finance: 

- We can provide PO and tax information once the amendment shows how invoices will be presented. Finance prefers two distinct invoices (Committed vs Carve-out) with separate invoice numbers so we can route them to different GL codes.
- For the carve-out invoice, we need usage detail per-region (us-east-1 / us-west-2) broken out in the invoice CSV; can you confirm marketplace will surface region-level usage?
- Please include the private offer ID on both the amendment and invoices. Our legal has a short review but they don't expect material redlines.

We can sign the DocuSign by EOD on 2028-05-20 provided the above is addressed. We'll send PO (PDF) once we receive your finalized amendment.

Procurement contact: Priya N. (procure@brightwave.com)
CloudOps contact: Miguel Torres <cloudops@brightwave.com>

— BrightWave Procurement

- John in Billing needs an invoice template for 'Committed' and a separate template for 'Carve-out (overage)'. I'll attach a sample.
- Marketplace (AWS) requires private offer ID and Seller Order ID in the invoice metadata; confirm with Jane.
- We should keep the carve-out CSV schema: date, region, product_code, tokens_consumed, effective_rate, line_total. That will satisfy BrightWave's CloudOps.

Kimberly — can you confirm legal is OK with the amendment language in section 3.2 (billing split) or suggest phrasing? I want to avoid a rework cycle.

Marcus
Sr. Manager, Renewals | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal amendment: invoice carve-out & capacity uplift (BrightWave)

Hi Priya / Miguel —

Appreciate the quick clarifications. We've updated the amendment and invoices to reflect the two-invoice approach and included example CSV output for the carve-out (region breakouts included). Summary of changes: 

- Two distinct invoices:
  * Invoice A (Committed): monthly committed amount, single invoice number, GL code field included.
  * Invoice B (Carve-out / Overage): separate invoice number per month; attached CSV example contains region-level lines (us-east-1 / us-west-2) with token counts and line totals.
- Private Offer ID and Seller Order ID will be embedded in the invoice metadata and printed on the PDF header.
- We've added a clause to the amendment that allows BrightWave to request an audit CSV for any month within 90 days.

Attachments: private_offer_amendment_v2.pdf, brightwave_evidence_manifest.xlsx, invoice_split_template.xlsx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=ABC-123-PO-AMP

Next steps:
1) Confirm: you want two invoices (yes/no).
2) If yes, please reply with PO number and legal entity exactly as it should appear.
3) We'll send DocuSign after your confirmation and route copies to Jane/AWS for marketplace metadata checks.

If you'd like an ops-level walkthrough of the carve-out CSV, Marcus and I can jump on a 20-min call tomorrow.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
